content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2.
